question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

He was __trembling __with fear.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Shivering**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"trembling"** means to shake involuntarily, typically as a result of anxiety, excitement, or frailty. (कांपना)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **trembling **with cold as she stood outside in the snow.
 
 
 
• **"Shivering" **refers to the act of shaking or trembling uncontrollably as a result of cold, fear, or excitement. (कांपना)
 
 
• **Example: **He was** shivering **with fear as he heard the strange noises from the dark alley.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'trembling' **is **'shivering'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Weeping** (रोना): Shedding tears; crying.

 
 
• **Example:** She was weeping after hearing the sad news.
 
 
 
• **Running** (दौड़ना): Moving at a speed faster than a walk.
 
 
• **Example: **He was running to catch the bus.
 
 
 
• **Intrepid** (निर्भीक): Fearless; adventurous.
 
 
• **Example:** The intrepid explorer ventured into unknown territories.
